Definition: from ἄθλος (a contest in the public lists); to contend in the competitive games:--strive.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says a man who strives for the mastery in the games is not crowned unless he strives lawfully, and the word is the athlete's word. It is the only place it appears.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Christian race has rules, and the crown goes to the one who runs it God's way, not the fastest way.
